summary: Chesapeake Utilities filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market equity program of up to $225,000,000 of common stock, par value $0.4867 per share, under an equity distribution agreement dated September 30, 2026. Managers include Barclays, Citizens JMP, Ladenburg, Morgan Stanley, RBC and TD Securities, with Barclays Bank, Morgan Stanley, RBC and TD acting as forward purchasers. Sales occur at prevailing NYSE market prices or in negotiated block transactions, with commissions up to 2%. Forward sale agreements permit borrowed-share sales with physical settlement. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and dilution.
